Natural Mosquito Control

With Sterile Insect Technic (SIT)

Contact

Senecio Robotics

Our technology offers a safe, environmentally friendly, and highly effective alternative to traditional mosquito control methods, such as chemical insecticides, which often lead to resistance and are harmful to the environment.

Read More

Why SIT?

  • Effective: Sterilized male mosquitoes are released in large numbers to mate with wild females, thus preventing the eggs from hatching and reducing mosquito populations.

  • Environmental: SIT targets only specific mosquito species and is harmless to all  other species and the environment.
